content: {"question":"Which GitLab people managers receive unlimited platform access through the Hone Partnership and are also required to apply the Learning Content Accessibility Guidelines when creating learning content?","answer":"GitLab people managers who are part of the Hone Partnership receive unlimited platform access and must apply the Learning Content Accessibility Guidelines when creating learning content.","evidence_a":"Unlimited platform access for GitLab people managers","evidence_b":"Apply these guidelines when creating learning content for internal and external use, when applicable"}
